title: Mobile SFA v1 HTTP envelopes
description: Versioned transport envelopes; domain constraints and proof-of-possession are enforced by the server.

referenceData.description: Opt in to products and stock in bootstrap pages and product/inventory pull changes (SP-0051). First page only; continuation pages follow the cursor. Additive optional field.

sequence.description: Optional MCP order of the day (lower first). Added 2026-10; older servers omit it.

code.description: Optional outlet (customer) code for the daily route screen. Added 2026-10; older servers omit it.

address.description: Optional outlet address used as the navigation fallback. Added 2026-10.

latitude.description: Optional current verified pin latitude; sent together with longitude or not at all. Added 2026-10.

longitude.description: Optional current verified pin longitude; sent together with latitude or not at all. Added 2026-10.

revision.description: Additive optional (referenceData): server millisecond revision; apply a later change only when its revision is >= the stored one.

callSheets.description: Annex C call sheet per account (outlet) in this page's planned visits. Additive optional field; old clients ignore it.

inventoryAvailability.description: Stock at the device unit's sale locations for catalog products (referenceData only). Quantities are integers in base units x product quantityScale. Additive optional field.

activityRules.description: AND-013: activity forms each visit intent requires or offers, from backend rules. Additive optional field; old clients ignore it. Unknown intents or kinds stay raw and are never satisfiable by a form the client lacks.

photoTypes.description: AND-016: photo types a visit photo may carry, from the backend. Additive optional field; old clients ignore it. The phone offers only these codes; the server rejects any other code on attach.

dayTarget.description: Optional daily position standard for the Today screen (client memo 2026-01-20, call answer 1). Added 2026-10; older servers and people without a position standard omit it.

productiveCallRule.description: Governed productive-call rule of the position (sfa/productive_call.ts): any_listed_activity or truck_seller. Absent means any_listed_activity; an open string so a later rule is not a breaking change.

daySales.description: Optional sales of the Manila day as the server has them, counted like the Daily Sales Report, in PHP centavos. Added 2026-10; older servers omit it, and it is omitted when the day exceeds one bounded read.

unplannedReason.description: Required by the server when plannedVisitId is null; omitted for planned visits.

reason.description: Optional specific rule behind a rejection (e.g. call_open, mcp_order, wrong_date); code stays a frozen v1 value. Clients treat unknown reasons as code.
